text: Suppose that $A$ is a symmetric matrix, that we list its eigenvalues in decreasing order $\lambda_1 \geq \lambda_2 \geq \ldots \geq \lambda_m$, and that $\uvec_1,\uvec_2,\ldots,\uvec_m$ is a basis of associated eigenvectors. The maximum value of $q_A(\uvec)$ among all unit vectors $\uvec$ is $\lambda_1$, which occurs in the direction $\uvec_1$. Similarly, the minimum value of $q_A(\uvec)$ is $\lambda_m$, which occurs in the direction $\uvec_m$.
